 ICSI CSEET October 2026 results out; Bhakti Sanjay Shah secures AIR 1
 Vaishnavi Shukla | November 15, 2026 | 02:20 PM IST | 1 min read
 Candidates can download the ICSI CSEET October 2026 scorecard from the official website at icsi.edu; Marks verification, answer sheet inspection facility opens tomorrow
 CSEET Exam Complete Guide
 Candidates can download this e-book to know all the details related to CSEET such as eligibility criteria, exam pattern, syllabus, study material and other related information.
 Check Now ICSI CSEET October 2026 scorecard out. (Representative Image: Wikimediacommons) The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) has announced the ICSI Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) October 2026 results today, November 15. Candidates can download the ICSI CSEET October 2026 scorecard from the official website at icsi.edu. Bhakti Sanjay Shah has secured All India Rank (AIR) 1 in CSEET October 2026 session exam.
 New: CSEET Oct 2026 Result Out - Direct Link   
 Don't Miss: CSEET exam complete guide |  CSEET exam new syllabus 
 ICSI conducted the CSEET 2026 exam from October 1 to 6.
 Candidates who are willing to review their performance in the exam can also apply to inspect their answer books or request certified copies through the SMASH portal. The application window for the answer sheet inspection facility will open on November 16 at 12:01 am and close on December 15. 
 The fee is Rs 450 per subject for answer book inspection and Rs 500 per subject for a certified copy.

 CSEET October Toppers 2026
 The list of CSEET October toppers 2026 is given below. 
 Candidates 
 All India Rank 
 Bhakti Sanjay Shah Rank 1 
 Abhimanyu Singh Rajput Rank 2 
 Manjiree Joshi Rank 3 
 CSEET October 2026 Result: How to check?
 The steps to check CSEET October 2026 result are as follows
 Visit the official website at icsi.edu.
 Click the CSEET October 2026 result link.
 Enter login details
 Check the result and subject-wise marks.
 Download the e-Result-cum-Marks Statement.
 Save the document for future use.
 ICSI CSEET October 2026 verification of marks
 Additionally, candidates who want to confirm that their marks have been calculated correctly can apply for verification through the ICSI SMASH portal. The application window opens on November 16 at 12:01 am, and candidates can apply within 21 days of the result declaration, with December 6 as the last date. The verification fee is Rs 250 per subject and is non-refundable.
